structure_delta.bounded: one decompose attempt per task, no recursion

policy: time: evict graphs unreferenced beyond a retention window
quality: nodes with recorded success-rate < 0.5 (over >=3 uses) deprioritized from reuse candidates
similarity: isomorphic subgraphs merged, keeping highest-quality version

demo.would_prune_now: none: every node has success evidence or version semantics
